args.summary:
Model of a three-span cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete box girder bridge (36+48+36 m, deck 16 m wide) completed successfully.

Structure/idealization: 2D spine-beam, linear elastic, system "continuous_on_piers" (twin-column piers modelled, bases fixed). Main girder: single-cell cast box, h=2.4 m; section integration gave A=8.417 m², I=7.1876 m⁴; C50 concrete Ec=34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5); γ=26.0 kN/m³ → w=218.84 kN/m, m=22.308 t/m (girder self-weight only).

Bearings (2 per line, parallel, stiffness summed):
- Abutments 0 & 3: PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric, 400×500 mm, 5×11 mm layers, Ge=1.2 MPa → S=10.10, Kv=3.614e6 kN/m, Kh=0 (longitudinally free).
- Pier 1: plain (fixed) laminated elastomeric, 600×700 mm, 7×11 mm → S=14.69, Kv=8.974e6 kN/m, Kh=13090.9 kN/m (longitudinally spring).
- Pier 2: PTFE sliding, 550×650 mm, 6×11 mm → S=13.54, Kv=8.075e6 kN/m, Kh=0.

Piers: twin circular columns D=1.6 m, C40 (Ec=32500 MPa), combined A=4.0212 m², I=0.6434 m⁴; heights 8 m (Pier 1) and 11 m (Pier 2).

Live load (JTG D60-2015 Class I, one-way, 4 lanes): qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=332/356/332 kN, transverse factor ξ=0.67. Modal analysis gave f1=2.980 Hz → impact factor μ=0.177 (4.3.2).

Results: modal frequencies 2.98/4.76/5.48 Hz; self-weight reactions ≈2835/10302/10281/2843 kN; self-weight mid-span moments ≈15.6/23.4/15.7 MN·m and support moments ≈-39.8/-39.5 MN·m; lane max positive moment 14.36 MN·m, max negative -11.48 MN·m. All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
